title: CompositionStep
description: Represents a single atomic step in the Instruction Composition lifecycle, including its instructions, status, and optional output. Each CompositionStep is defined by an identifier, a timestamp and a single Instruction.

identifier.description: Identification of the Instruction Composition step.

timestamp.description: Date and time of the execution of the Instruction Composition step after being executed.

compositionStepInstruction.description: Set of instructions defining the steps of each Instruction Composition process.
